decisions.reason: As a multi-model safety shoe line in the firm’s core business, it carries substantial sunk development and production investment, so management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course.

The comfort insole is more peripheral than the main footwear lines, but after surviving the earlier portfolio review it remains a useful complement to the core offer and is still more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
An ergonomic safety shoe series with its own dedicated presentation reflects a visible commitment in a strategically central category, which makes management strongly inclined to persist.

Firefighter and rescue boots are a specialized but credible extension of the protective-footwear business, and management can still justify staying the course on the basis of niche ramp-up and qualification cycles.
Because the moulded insole was publicly highlighted as a flagship direction, the firm is highly committed both strategically and reputationally and is therefore very unlikely to remove it soon.
